source: Pat's Daily Session Plans (email of 2026-11-07), with her answers of 2026-11-10. Red, Orange and Yellow end each rhyme with their own, in the rhyme's words.

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 1
coolDowns.text:
Touch your head, touch your nose, touch your knee.
Stand straight, feet together. Count to 10

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 2
coolDowns.text:
Stretch up high.
Stretch out wide.
Shake one hand. Shake the other hand. Shake both hands.
Stand straight, feet together. Count to 10

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 3
coolDowns.text:
Suck in the air slowly as though you are sucking through a straw– then blow out slowly.
Puff up your cheeks and blow hard.
Repeatedly make a ‘t’ sound.
Repeat 5 times

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 4
coolDowns.text:
Head and Shoulders
Roll head slowly round and around dropping it forward, chin on chest.
Roll one way and then the other 3 or 4 times.
Stand upright. Raise shoulders slowly up and down, then roll them forwards and backwards.
Take a deep breath in and hum ‘mmm’ on one continuous note.
Touch your:
Nose, ear, foot, ankles, chin, elbow, cheeks
Stand straight, arms by your side, eyes closed. Count to 10

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 5
coolDowns.text:
Foot Flex
Stand with feet apart. Lift the heel of one foot off the floor keep the ball of the foot touching the floor. Repeat 5 times.
Change feet
Rotate the foot one way in a circle three times and then the other way.
Repeat with the other foot.
Suck in the air slowly as though you are sucking through a straw– then blow out slowly.
Repeat ‘p’, ‘t’, ‘k’ sounds 5 times

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 6
coolDowns.text:
Stand feet apart arms by your side. Slowly raise your arms above your head and then back to your side.
Suck in the air slowly as though you are sucking through a straw– then blow out slowly.
Touch your nose, touch your elbow, touch your heel.
Stand on one leg for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
Stand arms by your side, eyes closed. Count back from 10.

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 1
coolDowns.text:
Pulling Faces
Puff up your cheeks with air – hold for a count of 3. Move the air from side to side. Slowly blow out the air. Repeat 3 times.
Repeatedly make a ‘p’ sound.
Suck in the air slowly as though you are sucking through a straw– then blow out slowly.
Repeat 5 times.
Touch your head, touch your nose, touch your knee.
Stand straight, feet together. Count to 10

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 2
coolDowns.text:
March on the spot.
Stretch out your fingers and toes like a starfish.
Make a fist with your thumb on top of your fingers and curl your toes over.
Squeeze and hold for 3 seconds (count aloud). Repeat 5 times
Stand arms by your side, eyes closed. Count back from 10.

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 3
coolDowns.text:
Walk slowly around the room.
Stop and change direction.
Pulling Faces
Puff up your cheeks with air – hold for a count of 3. Move the air from side to side. Slowly blow out the air. Repeat 3 times.
Repeatedly make a ‘p’ sound.
Suck in the air slowly as though you are sucking through a straw– then blow out slowly.
Repeat 5 times.
Stand arms by your side, eyes closed. Count back from 10.

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 4
coolDowns.text:
Hello fingers
Hold your hand up to one side and look at your fingers.
Other arm by your side making a fist with your hand (thumb on top).
Touch the tip of each finger with your thumb 5 times. Repeat starting with the little finger to the index finger.
Change sides and repeat.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 5
coolDowns.text:
Quick March (Lift knees up high when marching; place the ball of the foot down first followed by the heel)
March on the spot lifting your knee up high. At the same time touch each knee with the opposite hand. (touch each knee 5 times)
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 6
coolDowns.text:
The Flamingo
Looking straight ahead, raise both arms to the side. Lift one leg – knee forwards, then lower it to the floor – ball of the foot first rolling the foot down flat on the floor.
Repeat 5 times each side.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 1
coolDowns.text:
Thumbs Up
Feet slightly apart. Hold both arms out in front with fingers curled and thumbs up.
Look at one thumb nail and follow with the head as you slowly swing the arm round to be parallel with the shoulder. Hold for a count of 3 and then follow the thumb nail as you swing the arm back to the starting position.
Look at the other thumb nail and follow with the head as you slowly swing the arm round to be parallel with the other shoulder. Hold for a count of 3 and then follow the thumb nail as you slowly swing the arm back to the starting position.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 2
coolDowns.text:
Swop Overs
Stand with feet apart looking straight ahead.
Raise one arm up straight to point at the ceiling (still looking ahead) – other arm by your side.
Keep the arms straight and looking ahead change arms.
Repeat 5 times each side.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2,1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 3
coolDowns.text:
Fingers and Thumbs
Clasp your hands and then let go – repeat 3 times.
Hold your hands in front of you – facing each other with a small gap in the middle.
Touch your little fingers
Touch your third fingers
Touch your middle fingers
Touch your first fingers
Touch your thumbs.
Repeat starting with the thumbs
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2,1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 4
coolDowns.text:
Bend and stretch
Stand with feet apart looking straight ahead.
Bend forward letting the head and arms hang down.
Stretch up opening arms wide and tilting head back.
Repeat 5 times
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 5
coolDowns.text:
Pirouette
Stand straight with your arms clasped above your head.
Staying on the spot move slowly round in a circle.
Repeat 3 times each way.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2, 1

coolDowns.title: Cool Down 6
coolDowns.text:
Cross Overs
Stand straight – feet slightly apart, arms by your side.
Right hand to left shoulder and back again.
Left hand to right shoulder and back again.
Right hand to left knee and back again.
Left hand to right knee and back again.
Repeat the sequence 5 times.
Stand still, arms by your side eyes closed. 5, 4, 3, 2,1
